India's Domestic Air Passenger Traffic Declined in August

India's domestic air passenger traffic saw a decline of 6.34% in August compared to the same month last year, according to data from the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA). The total number of domestic air passengers in August was 12.13 million, down from 12.95 million in August of the previous year. IndiGo, a major airline, reportedly lost market share during this period.
